prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Thai woman — the personification of Bangkok — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Bangkok as her world knows it — a city of a myth-world on a great river: teak wood on tall stilts and carved gables, gilded carving and glittering mirror-glass mosaic, glazed tiles in green and orange, woven rattan, silk and lacquer, lantern-light on the water and drifting lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the palace spires, the river barges or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the great flower market by the river before dawn — heaps of roses, orchids, marigolds and jasmine under lantern-light, boats unloading baskets of blossoms at the landing and women threading jasmine garlands at low tables.
Around her, as her world makes them: a bouquet of fresh flowers with softly glowing petals tied with a silk ribbon; a strung garland of white jasmine buds and rosebuds with a dangling tassel of blossoms; a woven willow basket.
Season: the hot season — March to mid-May, fierce sun and heavy, sticky heat, April the hottest month of the year.
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet; a pale lilac sky, mist low on the ground.
Hair: a casual hat, cap or hood that suits the outfit, her hair showing beneath it — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: paint-flecked white painter's dungarees with one strap down over a cropped tee; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with a soft fine-knit texture and a silk ribbon tied in her hair; right now — a sudden rain shower or a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a brass-bound memory glass that keeps a captured image by its grip at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: paused mid-walk, weight on the front foot.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

observations: 정사각형 구도와 빗속 꽃시장, 어깨 너머 돌아본 얼굴이 보인다. 손에 든 소품은 계획의 카메라보다 둥근 유리 소품에 가깝다.
